definitions.explanation: A close emotional connection between people, often family or deep friendships.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{絆|きずな}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。
{絆|きずな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{深|ふか}める→深める：02407_fukameru⟧。
⟦{友情|ゆうじょう}→友情：03648_yuujou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{絆|きずな}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{結|むす}ばれている→結ぶ：02308_musubu⟧。
examples.english: We are connected by bonds of friendship.

notes:
Often used to describe important emotional connections between people. Became especially prominent after the 2011 earthquake as a symbol of community solidarity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{絆|きずな}を{深|ふか}める (deepen bonds)
・{絆|きずな}を{結|むす}ぶ (form bonds)
・{絆|きずな}が{強|つよ}い (have strong bonds)
・{家族|かぞく}の{絆|きずな} (family bonds)
・{友情|ゆうじょう}の{絆|きずな} (bonds of friendship)
